title: India's Education Minister resigns after protests from 'Cockroach Party' over medical exam leak
summary: Massive protests against corruption in university exams led to the minister's resignation and the beginning of talks to calm the crisis.

title: Japan records historic heat wave with five consecutive days of extreme temperatures
summary: Temperatures exceeded 40°C in several locations, setting a record for consecutive days of intense heat and triggering heatstroke warnings.

title: Tension rises in the Middle East: Kuwait and Bahrain attack Iranian military facilities
summary: According to reports, the attacks were aided by intelligence from the United Arab Emirates, while the United States shows willingness for dialogue.

title: Japan approves 'second capital' law as regions compete to host the new seat
summary: Parliament gives the green light to government decentralization, while Osaka, Fukuoka, and other cities apply, amid political controversies.

title: Figure skater Mao Shimada wins her senior debut with over 220 points
summary: The 16-year-old Japanese triumphed at the Aquarius Cup with a solid performance that establishes her as a figure skating prospect.

title: Yomiuri Giants defeat Hanshin Tigers and take sole possession of first place
summary: A four-run rally in the fourth inning, fueled by a home run from Dalbec, secured the victory and the top spot.

title: Japan commemorates the tenth anniversary of the Yamayuri-en massacre with a call for inclusion
summary: Relatives and authorities remember the 19 victims of the attack at the Sagamihara disability center and reiterate the need to eradicate discrimination.

title: Shigeki Iguchi appointed new manager of Japan's baseball team (Samurai Japan)
summary: A former Major League player and Olympic medalist, Iguchi takes on the role with the goal of merging tradition and strengths to conquer the world.

title: Sumo enters its final stretch with sekiwake Ansei-nishiki as leader and yokozuna Hōshōryu injured
summary: Ansei-nishiki seeks his third title, while the yokozuna withdrew due to a right leg injury, leaving the championship race open.

title: Prime Minister Takaichi's approval rating falls to 53% and criticism grows over her absence from Parliament
summary: The opposition and citizen groups protest her reduced attendance at the budget committee, while polls reflect a decline in support.

title: Seibu Lions come back against SoftBank Hawks with a huge six-run inning
summary: The Lions took advantage of the league leaders' errors to achieve a decisive victory that halts their winning streak.

title: Nippon-Ham Fighters win with a double by Narasawa in the ninth inning
summary: Shinjo's team achieved their third victory of the season with a walk-off, thanks to a timely hit by Narasawa.

title: Kazuyoshi Miura, 59, scores his first official goal since returning to competition
summary: The veteran forward scored in the Emperor's Cup qualifying round, his first goal since 2021.

title: Daizen Maeda signs for Ipswich Town and returns to the English Premier League
summary: The Japanese forward, from Celtic, commits to the English club until the summer of 2029.

title: T-League Table Tennis League opens season in Taiwan with victories by Nagoya and Tokyo
summary: The tournament, held abroad for the first time, attracted a large number of fans despite the high ticket prices.

title: Sumida fireworks festival lights up the Tokyo sky
summary: Thousands of people enjoyed the fireworks display along the Sumida River, with vibrant colors and shapes.

title: Traditional 'Kawabiki' begins to transport wood to the Ise Shrine
summary: About 3,600 participants dragged logs along the river at the start of preparations for the shrine's reconstruction in 2033.

title: Support grows for French plan to expand its 'nuclear umbrella' amid Russian threat
summary: Several European countries look favorably on France's proposal to extend its nuclear deterrence to protect against Russia.

title: Municipal bus hits second-grade child in Kawasaki after running a red light
summary: The driver said he did not brake to avoid injuring passengers, but the child was injured and taken to the hospital.

title: Electric saw with victim's DNA found in dismemberment homicide case
summary: The saw was put up for sale on an auction site after the crime, and police are investigating the seller.

title: Trump resumes dinner with journalists after assassination attempt and criticizes his opponents
summary: In a tense atmosphere, the former US president repeated personal attacks and suggested the possibility of a third term.

title: Jungleia theme park celebrates its first anniversary with one million visitors
summary: The complex has generated an economic impact of 49.4 billion yen, although its representative regrets not having achieved all goals.

title: Kozo Okamoto, sole survivor of the 1972 Lod Airport attack, dies in Lebanon
summary: The former Japanese Red Army member, who was serving a sentence in Lebanon, died from lung complications, and his funeral was attended by Palestinian leaders.
